description: Select the text field to populate.

name: InputTextAs

description: Choose how to input the text (plain or encrypted).

selectOptions.description: Use regular text, variable, or expression.

selectOptions.label: Direct Encrypted Text Input

name: Text
label: Text
description: The text to fill in the text field.

name: TextEncrypt
label: Encrypted Text
description: The text to fill in the text field securely.

name: IfFieldIsnTEmpty
label: If Field Isn't Empty
description: Specify what to do if the text field already contains data.

selectOptions.label: Replace Text
selectOptions.description: Clear existing content and replace with new text.

selectOptions.label: Append Text
selectOptions.description: Add new text to the end of existing content.

name: PopulateTextUsingPhysicalKeystrokes
label: Populate Using Physical Keystrokes
description: Emulate physical keystrokes when populating text to ensure compatibility with complex fields.

name: EmulateTyping
label: Emulate Typing
description: Fill the text field character by character to simulate typing behavior.

name: UnfocusTextBoxAfterFillingIt
label: Unfocus Text Box After Filling It
description: Unfocus the text box after filling it. Set to false if scraping auto-completion lists.

name: WaitForPageToLoad
label: Wait for Page to Load
description: Specify whether to wait for the new web page to load completely before proceeding.

name: TimeoutForWebpageToLoad
label: Timeout for Webpage to Load
description: Set the time in seconds for the page to load before the action throws an error.

name: IfAPopUpDialogAppears
label: If a Pop-Up Dialog Appears
description: Specify what to do if a pop-up dialog appears after clicking the link.

selectOptions.label: Close It
selectOptions.description: Automatically close any pop-up dialog that appears.

selectOptions.label: Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Press a specified button on the dialog.

selectOptions.label: Close It / Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Close or press a button on the dialog.

name: DialogButtonToPress

description: Enter the dialog button to press if a pop-up dialog appears.
